title: Isla Learns to Publish Puzzle Books
core_story: Isla enjoys puzzles, then tries to understand how Sudoku books are actually made. She starts overwhelmed by puzzles, solutions, layouts, interiors, covers, rights, and file organisation. The Sapiver Press Commercial Sudoku Publisher Starter Pack becomes the practical starting point: start with structured files, then build one book at a time.

funnel.message: Sapiver Press makes playable and printable puzzles, so the brand has a visible puzzle base before selling publishing files.
The customer wants to create Sudoku books but does not know where to start or how many moving parts are involved.
Isla discovers the commercial-use starter pack as a structured way into puzzle-book publishing.
Show factual pack contents: 900 puzzles, 900 solutions, Classic/Hyper/Diagonal, Easy/Medium/Hard, publishing files, and real sample/listing visuals where available.
The practical action is not 'get rich'; it is 'start with the files and build the book from there'.
